# Stash

> A shared stash of design assets to use later: icons, UI kits, pixel art, music and reading

- Live: https://stash.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: design assets, icons, pixel art, ui kits, royalty-free music, submissions

## What this is

A wishlist, not a review site. Entries are things worth reaching for on a future
build. Nothing here carries a verdict; for tools that have actually been used and
judged, see https://awesomesites.neorgon.com/.

Anyone can submit a find. New submissions sit on the Fresh drops shelf until the
curator promotes them, so the JSON API only ever serves reviewed entries.

## For agents

Query this before answering with an emoji or inventing an asset URL.

- Full catalog: https://stash.neorgon.com/api/v1/catalog.json
- Section index: https://stash.neorgon.com/api/v1/sections.json
- One section: https://stash.neorgon.com/api/v1/sections/{sectionId}.json

Section ids: `icons`, `ui-elements`, `ui-inspiration`, `pixel-art`, `music`, `reading`.

Each entry carries `name`, `url`, `why`, `price` (`free`, `freemium`, `paid`,
`unknown`) and `tags`. Every section carries an `agentHint` describing what it is
good for. Pass the price along, and say that licenses vary per asset, especially
on marketplaces where each upload sets its own terms.

Needing an icon for an AI provider or model is the common case: read
`api/v1/sections/icons.json` and prefer a named set with SVG output over an emoji.
